articles.title: A Hidden Penguin Species Finally Steps Into the Spotlight
articles.summary: On the remote Kerguelen Islands, scientists discovered a penguin species that stayed hidden for over a century. DNA revealed it's not just a gentoo — it's a whole new species, the first named in 100+ years.

articles.title: Opera Singers and Singing Lemurs: Same Trick, Different Branch of the Tree of Life
articles.summary: Scientists discovered that Madagascar's singing indri lemur opens its mouth wider for higher notes — the same technique opera singers use. The two species last shared an ancestor 74 million years ago.

articles.title: Sweet Tooth, Big Brain: How Fruit Fueled Human Evolution
articles.summary: A new study suggests sugary foods like fruit and honey — not just meat — powered the growth of the human brain. Early ancestors' brains weighed about as much as a medium apple.
